decisions.proposal: Repair existing application control flow and add one read-only next-action planner before general orchestration.
decisions.expected_value: Fewer unsupported ready/completed states and skipped prerequisites.
decisions.qualification: Known-bad and valid fixtures cover missing status, preflight failure, invalid stages, stale joins, login, absent user facts, prior submission and uncertain submission.
decisions.stop_or_narrow: False-ready states persist, valid work is blocked, or a smaller native/configuration repair handles the same responsibility.

decisions.proposal: Keep the existing observer and native worker; qualify one named trusted validation capability through its actual interface.
decisions.expected_value: Development diagnostics become available without replacing recording or enabling unqualified arbitrary execution.
decisions.qualification: Preserved invalid input fails, valid control passes, diagnostics identify checked bytes and attempts remain accounted for.
decisions.stop_or_narrow: The validator executes candidate code outside the qualified boundary, cannot expose reliable diagnostics, or duplicates an adequate native capability.

decisions.proposal: Use fixed code for known routes; add dynamic fan-out or model routing only for an observed variable task shape or unresolved judgment.
decisions.expected_value: Potentially reduce independent waiting or handle variable work without unnecessary model calls.
decisions.qualification: Independent ownership, bounded concurrency and shared allowance; include failed branches and compare actual elapsed time and total cost.
decisions.stop_or_narrow: Contention, duplicate work, partial-result mistakes or extra coordination outweigh the specific benefit.

decisions.proposal: Evaluate a pinned framework only when durable resume, concurrent workflow ownership or dynamic joins exceed current facilities.
decisions.expected_value: Possible reduction in recovery errors or implementation and maintenance burden.
decisions.qualification: Interrupt before/after a synthetic external effect, replay repeated events, preserve action authorization and deduplication, and compare with an equally equipped small controller.
decisions.stop_or_narrow: Migration adds cost without resolving the named requirement; uncertain effects duplicate or recovery semantics remain unqualified.

limitations: Documentation supports mechanism reuse, not local performance gains or novelty.
Deterministic control cannot certify semantic truth or compensate for bad input and weak acceptance.
The application graph exists in code as written but its controller does not currently parse; mutation bypasses remain.
MAQ-001 remains blocked. Graph control and execution isolation are separate concerns.
No change to installed skills, existing research freezes, live application state or tracker authority.
Preparation, evaluation and human effort are unpriced; no savings estimate is asserted.
